scenarios.title: Split second stops other spells and non-mana abilities
decisions: A casts Sudden Shock targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain and Mountain.
A passes priority. B receives priority with Sudden Shock on the stack and tries to cast Shock targeting player A, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: cast_spell
variants.expected: B's Shock cannot be cast: can_play is false.

variants.label: without_split_second
variants.delta: A casts Shock (no split second) targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping one Mountain, instead of Sudden Shock.
variants.expected: B's Shock can be cast in response: can_play is true.

operation.unclassifiable: a different spell is cast; no fork operation changes the cast

variants.label: activate_ability
variants.delta: B tries to activate Prodigal Sorcerer ({T}: 1 damage to any target) instead of casting Shock.
variants.expected: The activation is not allowed: can_play is false.

operation.unclassifiable: a different action: activating an ability instead of casting a spell

detector.outcome: A candidate spell or non-mana ability is refused by the split second check: a spell with split second is on the stack.
detector.near_miss: A candidate the split second check does not refuse.

scenarios.title: Mana abilities and special actions stay available under split second
decisions: A casts Sudden Shock targeting player B, tapping Mountain and Mountain.
A passes priority. B receives priority with Sudden Shock on the stack and tries to activate the mana ability of a Mountain.

variants.label: mana_ability
variants.expected: Tapping the Mountain for {R} is allowed: can_play is true.

variants.label: turn_face_up
variants.delta: B instead turns the face-down creature face up (a special action), paying its morph cost {1}{R}{R} with the three Mountains.
variants.expected: Turning Battering Craghorn face up is allowed and it becomes a 3/1 first striker.

operation.unclassifiable: a different action: a special action instead of a mana ability

variants.label: activate_ability
variants.delta: B instead tries to activate Prodigal Sorcerer ({T}: 1 damage to any target).
variants.expected: The activation is not allowed: can_play is false.

operation.unclassifiable: a different action: a non-mana ability instead of a mana ability

scenarios.title: Triggered abilities still trigger and go on the stack under split second
decisions: A casts Sudden Shock targeting player B, tapping Mountain and Mountain.
Young Pyromancer's trigger goes on the stack above Sudden Shock; both players pass and it resolves.
Both players pass again; Sudden Shock resolves.

variants.label: instant_cast
variants.expected: Young Pyromancer's trigger fires while Sudden Shock is on the stack and A gets a 1/1 red Elemental token. Sudden Shock then resolves and B's life is 18.

variants.label: creature_cast
variants.delta: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest and Mountain, instead of Sudden Shock.
variants.expected: Young Pyromancer's trigger does not fire and no token is created.

operation.unclassifiable: a different spell is cast; no fork operation changes the cast
